proposals.title: Configured relationship between application services
proposals.summary: The container composition adds a declared startup dependency and configured HTTP reference from backend to ai-engine.
proposals.rationale: This directional configuration materially enriches the existing containerization description without asserting successful runtime communication.

sections.name: Configured relationship
sections.content: The composition declares that backend starts after ai-engine and configures backend with an HTTP service reference to ai-engine. This establishes startup ordering and configured reachability only.

qualitativeGrounding.notes: Reviewed as limited to declared startup dependency, configured service reachability, and the explicit HTTP scheme. It does not assert successful runtime communication, API invocation, data exchange, network reliability, or post-start operational dependency.
